summary: Implemented TimeElapsedColumn and the finished-time latch in the rich repo. Changes: rich/progress.py adds Task.finished_time (default None, placed before visible), redefines Task.finished as finished_time is not None, clears finished_time in Task._reset() and Progress.reset(), captures elapsed as finished_time in update() and advance() once completed >= total (inside the lock, only if started), and adds TimeElapsedColumn between TimeRemainingColumn and FileSizeColumn. rich/default_styles.py registers progress.elapsed as yellow. CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased/Added entry. tests/test_progress.py adds test_time_elapsed_column and adds TimeElapsedColumn to the column-list integration test. Not verified: no tests were run per instructions. The integration test's expected output string was NOT updated, so that test will fail until it is regenerated. docs/source/progress.rst was not updated. No commits made.
